description: CR 702.14c whole card: islandwalk keeps the returned Towershell unblockable
note: The only window in which Meandering Towershell's islandwalk can be read: on the turn it is declared it exiles itself before blockers, so the return turn is where the keyword works. bob controls an Island and blocks with everything he can, so a Towershell without islandwalk would be blocked and deal nothing. A Wall and not a Piker because bob's turn falls between the two combats: defender keeps the Wall untapped, where a Piker would have attacked and be tapped, unable to block for a reason unrelated to evasion. The two Wall blocks on turn 3 are rejected (islandwalk makes them illegal) and asked again.
